amends: nba-multimarket-research-1.4 (docs/nba_multimarket_v14_20261021.md: relative missing value alone did not improve team markets); RUN071, v1.2, v1.3, v1.4 and the live v1.3 cohort untouched
inherits: multimarket_v14_protocol.json, multimarket_v13_protocol.json, multimarket_v12_protocol.json (sources, T-60 rule, windows, ridge, seeds, bootstrap, reference lines, G League category)
hypothesis: v1.3's absolute missing value also carried roster-depth information that the form window lags on; keeping it and adding the relative term (already-in-form absences removed) should recover that signal and add what v1.4 isolated

terms.absolute: sum trailing_value * (1 - play_probability), as in v1.3
terms.relative: sum trailing_value * (share_played - play_probability), as in v1.4
terms.winner_model: v1.2 logistic features + [abs_missing_points_home/10, abs_missing_points_away/10, rel_missing_points_home/10, rel_missing_points_away/10]; ridge prior 0 on all added weights, l2 0.002
terms.team_points_model: v1.2 ridge shift on [b2b_own, b2b_opp, abs_own/10, abs_opp/10, rel_own/10, rel_opp/10, 1]; penalty 5 on all but the intercept
terms.player_model: per market logistic on [logit(v1.2 probability), 1, own_questionable_or_doubtful, own_probable, teammates_abs_missing_minutes/48, teammates_rel_missing_minutes/48], ridge prior [1,0,0,0,0,0]

participation_floor.rule: play probability per category is clipped to [0.02, 0.98] after the Beta(1,1)-smoothed estimate; the 0.02 value is fixed a priori (about one chance in fifty that a listed Out plays) and is not tuned
participation_floor.applies_to: all categories, in the missing-value terms and in the participation log loss

variants.v13: reference: v1.3 exactly (absolute term, v1.3 categories, no floor)
variants.both: candidate: absolute + relative terms, G League category, floor
variants.abs_floor: ablation: absolute term only, G League category, floor
variants.both_nofloor: ablation: absolute + relative terms, G League category, no floor

primary_comparison: both vs v13 on identical rows, test seasons 2024-25 and 2025-26 only; paired Brier difference with 95% date bootstrap (400 replicates, seed 20261021). Secondary: both vs abs_floor (value of the relative term given the floor).
secondary: participation log loss of the floored and unfloored G League tables vs the v1.3 table on the same listed rows
fitted weights of the absolute and relative terms
decision_rule: adopt `both` for the team markets only if, in BOTH test seasons, the upper 95% bound of the paired Brier difference vs v13 is <= 0 for winner or team_points (at least one of them) and <= +0.0005 for the other; otherwise v1.3 stays. Improvement is reported, not promoted. The floor is adopted for the participation table if it lowers the participation log loss vs the v1.3 table in both seasons.
promotion: none; retrospective, seasons already inspected with v1.1-v1.4, exploratory; the live module keeps v1.3 until a separate change
not_modeled: report timing beyond the T-60 rule
